title: Halting of the selected machine branch
statement: Let $N$ assign a finite nondeterministic Turing machine to each bit, and let $x$ and $u$ be finite Boolean strings and $b$ a bit. The machine formed by the randomized branch construction halts on input $x$ after the choice string consisting of $b$ followed by $u$ if and only if the machine $N(b)$ halts on input $x$ after the choice string $u$.
hypotheses_covered: $N$ maps each Boolean value to a finite nondeterministic Turing machine over Boolean symbols
